text: At the end of your Command phase, any objective marker you control that the bearer's unit (attached unit included) is within range of stays under your control, even with no models in range, until your opponent's Level of Control there is greater than yours at the start or end of any turn.

name: Stealthy Hunter
text: The bearer gains Lone Operative and Stealth, and its master-crafted scoped bolt carbine gains [ANTI-INFANTRY 4+], [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] and [PRECISION].
